encoding_notes: SOURCE: live Meridian/KGL guide + PDF are Cloudflare-challenge-blocked to WebFetch/curl/Apify-headless and the live HTML guide is unarchived; encoded from the official NATA 'Journal of Athletic Training Author Guidelines' PDF via Wayback snapshot 20230615224046 of meridian.allenpress.com/DocumentLibrary/NATA/2020_JAT_Authors'_Guide.pdf. Same file still served live (challenge, not 404) and top July-2026 search hit -> treated as effectively current. AMA 11th ed (2020) = current edition. Confidence medium (could not diff vs live HTML).

Article-type mapping: Quantitative Original Research + Qualitative Original Research -> original_research; Systematic Review or Meta-Analysis -> systematic_review; Clinical CASE Report (4-tier CASE system) Level 1 Validation -> case_report and Level 2 Exploration CASE Series -> case_series (one guide category, shared word/ref caps); Short Report or Technical Note -> technical_note; Current Clinical Concepts (succinct narrative best-practice reviews, usually by invitation) -> review; Narrative Literature Review (normally solicited) -> narrative_review; Letter to the Editor -> letter.

OMITTED categories (no clean enum slot): 'Quality Improvement' (SQUIRE-based QI reports; distinct sections Local Problem/Background/Measurement/Design/Strategy/Results/Lessons and Limitations/Conclusions; 4000 words, 30 refs, 150-word unstructured abstract); 'Communications' (solicited NATA position/consensus statements); 'Media Reviews' (solicited, published in NATA News, not JAT).

WORD-CAP SPLIT inside original_research: Quantitative Original Research body = 4000 words / <=30 refs; Qualitative Original Research body = 5000 words / <=30 refs. Encoded 4000 (quantitative, the first-listed flagship + stricter cap); a QUALITATIVE original-research paper is allowed 5000. All body word counts EXCLUDE abstract, references, tables, and figures.

SCHEMA GAP combined figure+table caps: technical_note (Short Report/Technical Note) = 'No more than 3 tables or figures'; review (Current Clinical Concepts) = 'No more than 8 tables or figures'. These are COMBINED caps (tables + figures together); the schema only has separate figures_max/tables_max, so both left null to avoid a false-permissive independent cap (e.g. 3 tables AND 3 figures). original_research/systematic_review/case_report/case_series state no numeric table/figure cap.

MANDATORY 'Key Points' construct has no schema slot: every article type must supply 2-3 (case report/short report: 1-2) single-sentence 'take-home messages' placed immediately after the abstract; each key point max 30 words / 280 characters incl. spaces, supported by the study results. highlights_required left null (Key Points are JAT-specific, not Elsevier-style Highlights).

Layout: 'Each page must be formatted for 8.5- by 11-inch paper, double spaced, with 1-inch margins and a font no smaller than 10 points' -> page_size letter, line_spacing double, margins 25.4mm all sides. font.size_pt=10 is a stated MINIMUM ('no smaller than 10 points'), not a fixed size (10pt is compliant); font.family unstated -> null. 'Do not right justify pages' -> alignment left (ragged right). first_line_indent unstated.

line_numbers: guide says 'Include line counts on each page to facilitate the review process' -> line numbering REQUIRED (not 'none'); encoded 'continuous' but the phrase 'line counts on each page' is ambiguous between continuous and per_page (LOW confidence on which). page_numbers.show=true ('Begin numbering the pages... with the abstract page as #1; then consecutively number all successive pages'); position unstated. No running head prescribed.

Blinding: 'The JAT uses a double-blind review process. Authors and institutions should not be identified anywhere in the manuscript except on the title page' + 'The title page and acknowledgments as well as each table or figure must be uploaded as separate documents' -> double_blind, separate_title_page, scrub_body_identifiers all true. scrub_metadata left false: guide mandates a de-identified manuscript body but says nothing about scrubbing document/file properties metadata.

Title page (separate file) contains: brief title (16-word maximum RECOMMENDED, encoded as title_max_words=16), each author's name/title/affiliation/email/Twitter handle, and corresponding author name/address/phone/email. authors_degrees=include BUT capped: 'No more than 4 credentials should be listed for each author' (ATC preferred over state credentials) - the max-4 rule has no schema field. Trial/PROSPERO registration info goes at the BOTTOM of the title page (schema has no 'trial_registration' title_page element, so noted only here). Twitter handle also has no element.

Primary manuscript file order (each section on a new page): (a) Abstract, Key Words, Key Points on the first numbered page; (b) Text/body; (c) References; (d) Legends to figures. Abstract page is numbered page 1 and repeats the article title (no author names).

Abstract: primary type (Quantitative Original Research) structured, max 300 words, mandatory subheadings Context/Objective/Design/Setting/Patients or Other Participants/Main Outcome Measure(s)/Results/Conclusions, with Intervention(s) inserted after 'Patients or Other Participants' ONLY when appropriate (conditional - encoded in order). OTHER structured-abstract subheading sets (not encodable in the single abstract.sections field, all 300-word cap): Qualitative Orig Research = Context/Objective/Design/Setting/Patients or Other Participants/Data Collection and Analysis/Results/Conclusions (Design listed as 'Qualitative study'); Systematic Review/Meta-Analysis = Objective/Data Sources/Study Selection/Data Extraction/Data Synthesis/Conclusions. UNSTRUCTURED 150-word abstracts: Clinical CASE Report (PICO format), Quality Improvement, Short Report/Technical Note, Current Clinical Concepts.

Keywords: 3-5 for original research + systematic review; 2-3 for Clinical CASE Report, Short Report/Technical Note, Quality Improvement. Encoded min 3/max 5 (primary type); required=true. Keyword case + separator unstated -> null.

References: 'numbered consecutively, using superscripted Arabic numerals, in the order in which they are cited in the text' -> in_text superscript, order cited. 'Journal title abbreviations should conform to Index Medicus style' -> journal_abbrev nlm. 'See the American Medical Association Manual of Style, 11th edition' -> style ama. include_doi=false: the guide's worked reference examples (e.g. 'J Athl Train. 2020;55(1):42-48.') carry NO DOIs. et_al_threshold null (unstated; a 4-author example is listed in full, no truncation rule given). in_text_punctuation null (AMA superscript placement not stated in guide). No global max reference count (per-type caps live in word_limits).

Tables: 'each table... must be uploaded as separate documents. None of these should be included as part of the primary manuscript file' -> placement separate_file. 'numbered sequentially as they are cited in the text' -> numbering arabic. Title is bold, title-case ('first letter of each major word... capitalized'); caption_position left null (guide describes title typography but not above/below placement, though the bold title is listed first in the table-formatting sequence).

Figures: uploaded as separate documents (separate_files true); 'Minimum recommended resolution is 300 dots per inch' -> min_dpi 300; figures use Arial, white background, no surrounding box; multipart figures mounted together with Arial capital-letter labels (A, B, C). Figure LEGENDS live in the primary manuscript file as a dedicated 'Legends to figures' section (numbered with Arabic numerals in order of appearance) -> legends_location figure_legends_section. formats=[]: this guide does not enumerate accepted figure file formats - it defers to a separate 'JAT Figure Guidelines' document. callout_style + naming_pattern unstated -> null. Color reproduction must be requested in a cover letter and costs $100/figure.

Declarations: no single ordered end-of-manuscript declarations block, so order=[]; declarations are placed contextually. required (all conditional): funding ('Sources of financial support... must be acknowledged', with grant/contract numbers + funder name/city/state); conflict_of_interest (each author verifies COI + financial disclosures via emailed authorship/copyright form at submission); ethics_approval (state in Methods that an IRB approved the project for experimental human/animal studies); patient_consent (signed release required for each patient in a clinical CASE report and for any recognizable individual in photos/video); trial_registration (public registry required for clinical trials before/at enrollment; PROSPERO for systematic reviews/meta-analyses; both listed at bottom of title page). Non-author contributors thanked in a separate 'Acknowledgments' file. data_availability + author_contributions statements not required by the guide.

Misc: fully open access, NO publication fees, released to PubMed Central. orcid_required=false (ORCID not mentioned; a Twitter handle field IS requested on the title page). cover_letter_required=false (a cover letter is required ONLY when requesting color figures). title_case null: the guide gives a title-case rule for TABLE titles but does not state a capitalization rule for the manuscript/article title. Submission at jat.msubmit.net (eJournalPress). Revisions must be resubmitted within 3 months of the decision letter. ISSN not stated in the guide -> null.
